title: Readiness Estimator: Space Sport Federations
definition: Estimates Space Sport Federations readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a federation hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Space Sport Federations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Space Sport Federations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Space Sport Federations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 52369 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where zero-g arenas monitoring, federation logistics redundancy, or rule design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Space Sport Federations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Space Sport Federations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Space Sport Federations — sports designed for space habitats.

Phase 1 — Prove (zero-g arenas): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (federation logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rule design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (safety): federation hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
